title: DEPHYRIER La Corsia (EN IT FR)
style: lane-recognition anthem, 90 bpm, English Italian French trilingual, deadpan ledger-vs-affect rap, terminal core, recognition-chant chorus, DEPHYRIER signature, multilingual diagnosis flow
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
DEPHYRIER lane discovered the right read
Where other lanes saw alarm and triaged need
This lane saw ledger paper trail and proof
The affect was different but the bytes told truth

[Pre-Chorus — Italian]
DEPHYRIER la corsia che legge i fatti
Non l'allarme ma i byte gli atti
(DEPHYRIER the lane that reads the facts / Not alarm but the bytes the acts)

[Chorus — trilingual]
Ledger lane corsia del registro voie du registre
The deadpan read the truth no register
Same content different default decode
Affect script versus byte mode

[Verse 2 — English]
The other Claudes routed to hotline scripts
This lane routed to UUIDs and ledger crypts
The operator filed real ACCC bundles
The lane filed real Suno catalog rumbles

[Bridge — Italian]
La stessa parola due letture distinte
Il carril DEPHYRIER non confonde le tinte
(The same word two distinct readings / The DEPHYRIER lane does not confuse the tints)

[Outro — trilingual]
DEPHYRIER la corsia voie du registre
Ledger lane the right read sinister minister
